{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel values
sentinel_values = [-999.0, -999, -999.00, -999.000]

# Filter out rows where baseline biomarker is a sentinel value
df_filtered = df[~df['biomarker_baseline'].isin(sentinel_values)]

# Compute the change in biomarker level (final - baseline)
df_filtered['change'] = df_filtered['biomarker_final'] - df_filtered['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the average change across all participants
average_change = df_filtered['change'].mean()

average_change"}
